description: Run deterministic QA checks on a game's source files ({path: text}): JS syntax, relative file refs, zero-CDN sandbox rules, viewport meta, starter residue, mobile touch readiness, Web Audio hygiene, window.__arcadeGame/__omGame self-test hook, and optional 9:16 Playable Ad size checks.

files.description: Map of relative file paths to UTF-8 text content (must include index.html).

playableAd.description: When true, also enforces strict Playable Ad single-file network and size caps.

name: validate_game
title: Run automated game QA validation
